name: Linked sessions
description: Runs of agent teams read as their sessions on one clock: one lane per session with each subagent under the session that spawned it, every tool call a mark coloured by any field or by the analyst's labels, filters on every field and on time, a session's transcript with the other sessions at the same moment, and sessions or runs compared side by side.
data: One folder per run, as the harness wrote it. The transcripts, runs/*.jsonl: runs/<run>/<session>.jsonl is the lead's and runs/<run>/<session>/subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl each subagent's, a subagent's own subagents included. A transcript line has `type` (user or assistant), `uuid`, `parentUuid`, `timestamp` and `message`, whose content is a prompt string or a list of text, tool_use and tool_result blocks (a Task call's input holds the subagent's prompt and subagent_type), and some lines a `toolUseResult`, the harness's copy of a result ({agentId} for a Task, {filenames} for a Grep, a string for an error). runs/*/sessions-index.json: `version`, `team` and the sessions, as `sessions` [{session_id, agent, file}] in version 1 or `entries` [{sessionId, agentId, agentType, path, created, messageCount}] in version 2. The reader handles timestamps in ISO 8601 with Z or an offset, with or without milliseconds, or in epoch milliseconds; lines written twice (the same uuid) or out of order; the truncated last line of a session that was cut off, reported with any other line that does not parse; an index that misses a session on disk and lists one that is gone (the files on disk win); isError in version 1 and is_error later, and the Task tool renamed Agent; a Task call found for its subagent by toolUseResult.agentId, by "agentId: <id>" in the result's text, or by the prompt it sent; and facts only in free text: a command's exit code, a permission denial, a Grep's matched files and the files a command ran against.

accepts.means: the line <n>: in a transcript, a call (its tool_use or its tool_result line) or a message shown in its session's transcript; in a run's index, the run

units.means: one run: its sessions, with the view narrowed to it
one session: its lane and its whole transcript
